title: Northwestern Ojibwa - Wikipedia
text: Northwestern Ojibwe (also known as Northern Ojibwa, Ojibway, Ojibwe) is a dialect of the Ojibwe language, spoken in Ontario and Manitoba, Canada.

title: Ojibwa, Northwestern | Ethnologue Free
text: Northwestern Ojibwa is an endangered indigenous language of Canada. It belongs to the Algic language family and is part of the Ojibwa macrolanguage. Direct evidence is lacking, but the language is thought to be used as a first language by adults only.
